description: This is an abstract Java class named AbstractJDBCDao that provides database connection setup and management functionalities, specifically for a MySQL database within a larger enterprise application. It encapsulates the logic for loading the JDBC driver and obtaining database connections.

classes.name: AbstractJDBCDao
classes.description: An abstract class providing JDBC database connection setup and management functionalities for MySQL databases.

methods.name: setupDBDriver
methods.description: Loads the MySQL JDBC driver class to enable database connectivity.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a connection to the database using configured connection parameters.
